image_description: A side-profile view of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting on dry, sandy ground with sparse green vegetation. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, large upright ears with dark tips, and a visible short tail with white fur underneath. Its hind legs are tucked beneath its body, and forelegs are partially visible supporting its posture.
